name: Just Duplicate
author: Just There

sections.description:
Just Duplicate is the ultimate WordPress plugin for duplicating content effortlessly. Whether you’re managing a blog, an e-commerce store, or a custom content-driven website, this plugin empowers you to duplicate pages, posts, custom post types, menus, media, and WooCommerce products with just one click.

Designed for speed and efficiency, Just Duplicate eliminates repetitive tasks, saving you time and effort. With advanced features like role-based access control, batch duplication, and customizable settings, you can tailor the duplication process to your needs. The plugin is lightweight, fast, and fully compatible with popular page builders like Elementor, Divi, and Gutenberg.

👉 Simplify your WordPress content management with Just Duplicate – the easiest and fastest way to duplicate WordPress content.

Key Features:
✅ One-Click Duplication – Quickly duplicate posts, pages, custom post types, and WooCommerce products.
🚀 Batch Duplication – Duplicate multiple items simultaneously to boost productivity.
⚙️ Customizable Duplication Settings – Choose what to copy: meta fields, taxonomies, attachments, featured images, and more.
🔑 Role-Based Access Control – Restrict duplication permissions to specific user roles for better security.
📂 Automatic Prefix/Suffix – Add default text to duplicated items for easy identification.
🛠️ Seamless Compatibility – Works flawlessly with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and other major page builders and themes.
📢 Lightweight and Optimized – No bloat, just speed and performance.

Why Choose Just Duplicate?
– Save time by automating repetitive content creation tasks.
– Maintain consistency across your website with accurate duplication.
– Enhance workflow with advanced features like batch duplication and role-based access control.

For more details, visit our website.

How to Use

  • In the Posts/Pages list: hover a row to see two links — “Clone” (duplicates and returns to the list) and “New Draft” (opens the editor for the copy).
  • In the Classic editor: find the buttons in the Publish box.
  • In the Block editor (Gutenberg): open the sidebar panel to find “Clone” and “New Draft” buttons.
  • In the Admin Bar (optional): use the Duplicate menu for quick actions.
  • Bulk actions: Select items in the list table, choose “Duplicate” from Bulk actions, and apply.

Settings

Go to Settings → Just Duplicate to configure:

  • Where to show links: Row actions, Submitbox (edit screen), Admin Bar, and Bulk actions.
  • Who can duplicate: Allow specific roles and limit to selected post types.
  • What to copy: Author, date, password, excerpt, template, post format, sticky, menu order (with optional increment), taxonomies, and meta.
  • Blacklists: Exclude specific meta keys or taxonomies using CSV with wildcard support (e.g., edit*).
  • Attachments: Reference original media or duplicate media files and remap references.
  • Children: Copy one level of child posts to preserve simple hierarchies.
  • Redirect after duplicate: Go back to list, open editor, or view the original.
  • Title/slug patterns: Continue using your existing title/slug patterns without breaking changes.

Advanced:

  • Original surfacing: Add an “Original” column in the list table, a “Copy” post state label, and/or an “Original” meta box on the edit screen.
  • Rewrite & Republish: Create a working copy of a post; when published, its changes replace the original content while preserving the original ID/URL.

sections.installation:
From the WordPress Admin:
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
2. Search for “Just Duplicate”.
3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress Repository or GitHub Repository.
2. Upload the extracted folder to wp-content/plugins/.
3. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins, find “Just Duplicate”, and click Activate.
sections.faq:
How do I duplicate a post or page?

Hover over any post or page in your WordPress dashboard. You’ll see a “Duplicate” option. Click it, and a new draft will be created instantly.

Can I duplicate WooCommerce products?

Yes! Just Duplicate fully supports duplicating WooCommerce products, including their variations, images, and metadata.

Can I customize what gets copied?

Absolutely. You can choose whether to duplicate post meta, taxonomies, attachments, and featured images. You can also add prefixes or suffixes to duplicated content.

Is Just Duplicate compatible with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Yes! The plugin is fully compatible with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and other major page builders. Duplicated content retains all its layout and settings.

Can I limit who can duplicate content?

Yes! With role-based access control, you can define which user roles (Admins, Editors, Authors) have permission to duplicate content.

Does Just Duplicate affect website performance?

No, Just Duplicate is lightweight and optimized for performance. It does not slow down your website or interfere with other plugins.

Where can I get support if I have issues?

For support, visit our support page or ask in the WordPress support forum.
